subject: CON10

profile.brain_mask: own official corrected DWI b<50 mean; LAS FSL BET -m -f0.2 -g-0.05 -R; native-grid return
profile.response_mask: pinned MRtrix3.0.3 dwi2mask legacy default on own corrected DWI
profile.FOD_mask: official BET brain mask, six-neighbour dilation2
profile.normalise_mask: official BET brain mask, six-neighbour erosion2
profile.shells: own official mrinfo shell clustering; bvalue_scaling no; exported rotated FSL gradients
profile.response_lmax: pinned Dhollander defaults matching frozen response shape; actual response tables retained
profile.comparison_scope: independent stage lineage with matching parameter/mask definitions, not matching mask voxel values or isolated solver inputs
profile.upstream_EDDY_solver: official FSL eddy_cpu, GPU_UUID=null; CPU wall separate from failed GPU attempts

raw_frame_selection.device: actual formal FNIT GPU/TF32 selection; raw frame index identified by exact native packing, CPU proposal preserved separately

evidence.subject: CON10
evidence.verification: canonical raw frame arrays and affine equal to own pair and actual formal FNIT packing; exact actual solver/source/flags/nullUUID; all raw SHA verified

lineage: Own official rawprep -> own official response -> own official MSMT-CSD -> own official mtnormalise. No FNIT frozen PT/response/FOD.
